reason: RepoAtlas primarily analyzes unfamiliar repositories using bounded, evidence-backed inspection and supports reviewable change-proposal lifecycles; read-only analysis is the default, while opt-in local controlled actions justify elevated risk.

summaries.zh: RepoAtlas 是一个基于有界证据分析代码库并审阅变更提案的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
summaries.en: RepoAtlas is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for bounded, evidence-backed repository analysis and review of proposed changes.

capabilities: TypeScript/JavaScript syntax and relationship confirmation without executing repository code
bounded patch review, verification, export, and isolated local Git lifecycle observations
opt-in controlled local actions requiring approval and sandbox checks
